evidence.quote: The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 2,000 EUR

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states 2,000 EUR per semester for non-EU applicants, but that page does not say 'per semester' in the same sentence; TUM's general tuition page says fees for bachelor's programmes are 'usually 2,000 or 3,000 euros per semester', so the period is taken as semester. No document list and no application channel are stated on the supplied pages; the only application-period quote ('15 May - 15 July') does not state a year, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline, and the page does not label it as being for non-EU applicants specifically.

note.fr: Vérifiez sur le site TUM (tum.de) si vous devez demander une VPD via uni-assist et quels documents fournir pour votre Bac marocain.
note.en: Check on the TUM website (tum.de) whether you must obtain a VPD via uni-assist and which documents to submit for your Moroccan Baccalaureate.

evidence.quote: More information about the application process is available on the website: https://www.tum.de/en/studies/degree-programs/detail/sustainable-engineering-for-materials-and-processes-bachelor-of-science-bsc.
